voter_total_weight.meaning: IVoter(voter).totalWeight() value observed at the time notifyRewardAmount() is called

notified_emissions_tracked.meaning: whether the emission tokens transferred by notifyRewardAmount() are tracked/allocated so they can later be distributed to gauges

notified_emissions_should_be_tracked.meaning: report-required state: notified emission tokens are tracked and recoverable rather than permanently stranded in GaugeManager

unclaimable_funds_created.meaning: transferred emission tokens remain in GaugeManager indefinitely with no recovery mechanism, i.e. unclaimable funds are created

assumptions: notifyRewardAmount() is invoked and transfers base emission tokens into GaugeManager as described in the report.

unresolved.description: The intent's required relation (notified emissions must not remain untracked/stranded) and the impact (unclaimable funds created) are both qualitative; the report gives no numeric or structural observable distinguishing tracked vs stranded tokens, so the correspondence is expressed via derived booleans pending stage-3 binding.

limitations: Tracked/stranded status of notified emissions is represented by derived booleans because the report does not state a concrete index or balance observable for it.
The correspondence condition uses the tracked-status boolean itself; stage-3 binding must supply a concrete observable for tracked vs stranded emissions.

links.reported_relation: When totalWeight is zero at notifyRewardAmount(), tokens are transferred but no index update occurs, so the notified emissions are never allocated and become permanently inaccessible.
No mechanism tracks or redistributes the transferred emissions, so previously unaccounted emissions remain stranded indefinitely, creating unclaimable funds.
